messages:
maya: Noticed a spike of 403/handshake errors for east->eu traffic after the RBAC tighten earlier. Anyone oncall seeing TLS failures?
jon: Yep. Proxy ingress in eu-west is reporting client cert missing. Quick excerpt: 
```
time=2025-01-14T09:04:12Z level=error msg=mtls handshake failed peer=10.2.3.4 err="x509: certificate signed by unknown authority" trace=xyz
```
ops-oncall: I correlated with KMS logs 9:04:11 and there are decrypt denies for the wrapping key. Example: 
```
KMS: decrypt denied principal=svc-proxy-eu-west request_id=zz-998 resource=projects/keystore/key/prod-wrap reason=iam.permission.denied
```
luis: If unwrap failed, proxy can't load its private key so it won't present a client cert. That would show up as empty client certs in captures.
maya: Can we confirm the RBAC change timing vs rotator write?
jon: Rotator pushed new cert bundle at 09:03:50, RBAC deny applied at 09:04:05. So ~15s window where readers were revoked after write.
ops-oncall: Packet capture from a failing pod shows ClientHello without cert. Confirmed.
security-bot: Automated check: RBAC change PR #6123 matched pattern where keystore read was removed from a service role without validating keystore reads. 6 related IAM deny entries found.
luis: Root cause = ordering: write -> revoke read. Fix is to ensure read remains until all peers have consumed bundle. Proposals: 
- orchestration gate: verify keystore readability from all affected service accounts in all regions before applying deny
- extend rotator to emit checksum and have readers ack receipt; only then flip deny
- surface KMS deny events into nightly audit table with principal mapping to serviceaccount
jon: For immediate mitigation we should: 1) restore read permission for svc-proxy in eu-west, 2) force rotator to replay the bundle and rotate again to pick up keys, 3) temporarily relax TLS client-auth on cross-region path while we reconcile (targeted fallback).
maya: I'll open the revert. ops-oncall: Revert PR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/6180  rolling now.
ops-oncall: Also added a short-term runbook entry under incidents/keystore-ordering: check rotator timestamps, check KMS deny window, and run 'keystore-read-check' script.
luis: Long-term RFC ideas: 
- implement write-then-ack pattern: rotator writes bundle with version tag, readers poll and ack version; orchestration only flips RBAC after ack from N replicas/regions
- add preflight step that runs a KMS decrypt smoke test as the affected service principal (via a limited impersonation token)
- stream IAM denies with full request/response to BigQuery and link deny->PR/commit for faster triage
jon: Also suggest scheduled nightly compliance scan: compare live TLS knobs across services to canonical policy (min_version, client_auth mode, ciphers). If a rollout changes a knob unexpectedly, auto-run the keystore-read preflight and block if it fails.
maya: Assignments: maya -> revert + incident note; luis -> draft RFC for write-ack gating + KMS audit export schema; jon -> add keystore reconciler and smoke test harness; ops-oncall -> update playbook and run targeted fallback for cross-region paths.
keystore-bot: NOTICE: replayed bundle v=20250114-090350 to eu-west on request of ops-oncall at 09:06:20.
ops-oncall: After revert and replay, handshakes recovered. Monitoring shows error rate back to baseline. Will include precise timeline in postmortem.
maya: Good recovery. Follow-up: make the gating tests mandatory in rollout CI for any RBAC changes that touch keystore/KMS principals.
jon: And add alerting: KMS decrypt denies > 5 for a principal within 1m should page security oncall.
luis: I'll start the BigQuery export pipeline PR and put a demo dashboard for immediate triage queries.
maya: Thanks all. Saving thread for RCA notes. :white_check_mark:
